t: Citation Network Analyzer: a plain-language overview
title: Citation Network Analyzer: a plain-language overview
description: Overview: what the Citation Network Analyzer does and why archives need it. A citation network analyzer draws the map of who references whom: papers citing papers, articles citing articles. From that map it finds the most influential works, the tight research communities, and how ideas flowed over time. A pile of references becomes a landscape of influence.
provenance: Public methods compiled from standard information-extraction and knowledge-organization practice. Assembled for the JAH Databases archive.

t: How the Citation Network Analyzer works
title: How the Citation Network Analyzer works
description: Overview: what the Citation Network Analyzer does and why archives need it. Real analyzers parse reference lists (GROBID, regex-based parsers) into structured citations, resolve them to canonical works, and build a directed graph where edges mean 'cites'. PageRank scores each node's influence, co-citation analysis finds papers frequently cited together (research fronts), and temporal slicing shows how influence shifts across decades. The output is ranked influence lists, community clusters, and citation timelines.
provenance: Public methods compiled from standard information-extraction and knowledge-organization practice. Assembled for the JAH Databases archive.

t: How the Citation Network Analyzer works: the deep tour
title: How the Citation Network Analyzer works: the deep tour
description: Overview: what the Citation Network Analyzer does and why archives need it. Real analyzers parse reference lists (GROBID, regex-based parsers) into structured citations, resolve them to canonical works, and build a directed graph where edges mean 'cites'. PageRank scores each node's influence, co-citation analysis finds papers frequently cited together (research fronts), and temporal slicing shows how influence shifts across decades. The output is ranked influence lists, community clusters, and citation timelines. Advanced systems disambiguate author names in citations, detect citation cartels (groups citing each other excessively), and weight citations by context (a methods citation differs from a passing mention). Quality is measured against curated citation databases and by resolution accuracy. The limits are incomplete reference data and citation bias — highly cited is not the same as correct — so the analyzer reports influence, never truth, and marks its coverage gaps.
provenance: Public methods compiled from standard information-extraction and knowledge-organization practice. Assembled for the JAH Databases archive.
